title: bio 0.3.2
text: Preference-file resets now transactional: failed preset reads writes restore original file exactly, remove partial output original file existed. Errors encountered applying preferences longer hidden. rollback applied outside live RStudio session; running IDE owns rstudio-prefs.json, file neither deleted restored running. theme change ~/R/main directory applied preference reset actually succeeded. preference key running RStudio version accept longer aborts whole reset. Rejected keys collected reported one warning, remaining keys still applied. Unreadable preset JSON still aborts rolls back. secure = FALSE now warns dictionary archive fetched unencrypted connection extracted RStudio configuration directory. Dictionary archives containing entries escape target directory (absolute paths, drive letters, .. segments) refused extraction. failed dictionary download now says archive rejected — data, readable zip, unsafe entries, missing locale — instead always reporting incomplete download. Retries also back attempts. check newest available R version discovers CRAN source directories instead assuming R 4, filename pattern now requires literal dots. rstudio_install_spellcheck_dictionaries() now works outside RStudio downloading validating Posit’s dictionary archive, retrying interrupted transfers, falling back system curl command available. reports progress UI messages invisibly returns success status. rstudio_download_spellcheck_dictionaries() remains compatibility alias. Dictionary installation longer reports success extraction fails. utils::unzip() signals extraction problems warnings rather errors, result now confirmed dictionary files actually reached target directory. RStudio Desktop detection longer mistakes local runtime state directory installation directory. rstudio_configure_defaults() longer creates deletes ~/Desktop/BS-pratybos/. Deleting student’s course folder without confirmation unsafe, step dropped; create folder manually need . ~/R/main still created rstudio_reset_user_settings() bio-* presets.

title: bio 0.3.2
text: Added three Quarto vignettes (bio, checking--setup, rstudio-settings), marked lifecycle: experimental. code chunks evaluated, badge vendored vignettes render without network access. Expanded package description replaced broad backup.tools namespace import package-qualified calls single narrow import required open_backup_dir() re-export. Removed obsolete global-variable declarations, modernized interactive examples, clarified generated ..Rcheck/ ignore rule. Online R, RStudio, Quarto version checks now treat connectivity, transport, parsing, unexpected-response failures unavailable version information instead aborting program checks. GitHub Actions now tests installed-package behavior across current, devel, older R releases. Package publication generated-documentation jobs serialized, deployment failures remain visible, documentation jobs follow current R release rather hardcoded patch version. Generated documentation committed back -repository pull-request branches; read-fork pull requests receive patch artifact. Regression coverage expanded preference rollback, confirmation reset summaries, malformed version responses, dictionary installation, bundled JSON assets, deterministic internal helpers. test suite longer reaches real network: connectivity probe mocked everywhere online version check exercised, results longer depend runner connectivity. lint workflow now fails lintr reports findings (LINTR_ERROR_ON_LINT), package lint-clean. .lintr documents object_usage_linter disabled (glue interpolation usethis::ui_*()) allows camelCase names required external APIs.

title: bio 0.3.1
text: rstudio_compare_user_settings() prints short, readable summary default (many settings match, plus grouped list differs) instead raw waldo::compare() dump. Use new output argument control verbosity: "concise" (default), "minimal" (counts ), "verbose" (full waldo::compare() output debugging). New source argument ("auto", "live", "file") controls “current” settings read: live via rstudioapi (requires running RStudio session), saved rstudio-prefs.json file disk, automatically picking whichever available. rstudio_compare_user_settings() now works without running RStudio session, comparing saved rstudio-prefs.json file instead failing. Settings left RStudio’s built-default (therefore absent file) backfilled locally installed RStudio’s preference schema, ’re longer misreported “missing” — including nested settings like panes$hiddenTabSet.

title: bio 0.3.1
text: rstudio_reset_user_settings() rstudio_set_preferences() now work called outside RStudio (e.g. via Rscript), merging preference JSON files directly instead requiring live rstudioapi session. rstudio_reset_gmc() split rstudio_configure_defaults() (headless-capable: preferences, keybindings, snippets, directories, dictionaries) rstudio_reset_session_state() (requires live RStudio session: tabs, workspace, layout, theme, console, history). rstudio_reset_gmc() remains thin wrapper calling , backward compatibility. Added internal helpers detecting installed (necessarily running) RStudio Desktop version, used support . New get_rstudio_install_scope() reports whether local RStudio Desktop install system-wide (“users”) per-user (“just ”). find_rstudio_install_dir() now looks , checking per-user registry hive Windows previously missed.

title: bio 0.3.1
text: Documentation AI-assistant context files updated match current behavior. Fixed rstudio_delete_spellcheck_dictionaries(ask = FALSE), previously fail removing selected dictionary directory. Fixed open_project() called supplied proj_list proj_list_path. Fixed get_path_rstudio_config_dir() XDG_CONFIG_HOME set appending rstudio sub-directory per XDG Base Directory specification. Added isolated regression coverage dictionary deletion canceled RStudio user-settings resets. Added mocked regression coverage RStudio restart/reload commands spellcheck dictionary installation. Expanded automated coverage across exported package, path, project, file opening, RStudio integration, offline program-information helpers. Fixed clear_r_history() use RStudio’s history commands live RStudio session, including Windows. Clarified bundled rstudio-default preset compiled recent official RStudio settings documentation available 2022; setting comparisons use locally installed RStudio schema available. Added regression coverage open_project() availability filtering duplicate project names outside interactive RStudio session. Updated RStudio Desktop support links Posit’s current support site corrected current Linux/macOS internal-state paths ~/.local/share/rstudio. Updated remaining RStudio documentation links docs.posit.co documented unverified Windows/RStudio command-history reset behavior. Fixed RStudio install-scope classification tests non-Windows runners made per-user path detection separator- path-boundary-safe. Removed retired, commented-implementation experiments package source.
